title: The Cavalier Knight Chessboard Quest
statement:
A knight is placed on an N x N chessboard at starting position (StartX, StartY). The knight moves in L-shapes (2 cells in one direction, 1 in the perpendicular direction).

Find the minimum number of knight moves required to reach target square (TargetX, TargetY). If the target is unreachable, print -1.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: Four space-separated integers StartX, StartY, TargetX, TargetY (0-based).
constraints: 1 <= N <= 300, 0 <= StartX, StartY, TargetX, TargetY < N

sampleCases.explanation: A knight requires 6 moves from (0,0) to (7,7).
